object: steel transport crate (offshore cargo box): welded frame with corner castings and forklift pockets, sheet panels between
understanding: The frame and corner castings are thick section and carry the load; they scuff and rust but do not move. The sheet panels between them take the hits and dish inward.
Hurt by forklift tines, crane swings against other cargo, and things dropped on the lid. Not crushed flat or folded: the frame would have to fail first.
Paint goes on every outside corner and edge. Rust runs from the corners and latches, along the bottom rails where water sits, and inside each dent.
